# Project Governance 4.5.4

An explicitly cooperating chat can release its own project startup reservation without ending the
chat or restarting a shared native host. This lets a normal runtime update proceed after all affected
owners and running commands have safely relinquished the old generation.

- Add `startup relinquish` with exact native chat, binding, host, workspace and registry checks.
- Retain command, workflow, provider and other chat readers; normal activation still requires drain.
- Preserve open tasks, genuine native close events and exact original-owner history across interruption.
- Keep ordinary absent-host recovery strict. The verified newer archive can bootstrap the explicit
  release command against the older selected installation without editing its payload.

On resume, use the project's current pinned runtime and refresh context after a changed lock.
The command is a cooperative handoff; it does not stop unmanaged processes or prove completed work.

This release includes the previously shipped bundled npm dependency metadata correction and cleanup
repairs through its stable 4.5.3 base. It does not automatically upgrade any project.
